briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google race toward multimodal AGI milestones as compute constraints tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record funding. Global competition intensifies with new safety regulations emerging. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced agentic capabilities. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B while xAI and DeepSeek push inference efficiency gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New EU AI Act enforcement begins targeting high-risk systems. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 2M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce joint 10GW data center expansion. TSMC secures new AI chip orders from multiple labs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2028?
